description.value: A family-run lakeside resort with 2,000 ft of waterfront on Sheridan Lake, offering RV sites and cabins (no listed tent camping) with showers, laundry, boat rentals, and fishing; cyclists can use a cabin or hookup site but this is primarily an RV destination.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at loonbayresort.com is fully accessible and provides comprehensive evidence confirming an active, family-run lakeside resort on Sheridan Lake near Lone Butte, BC. The contact page and footer consistently show the address (7250 Texas Rd., Lone Butte, BC, V0K 1X1) and phone (250) 593-4431, the latter of which was absent from OSM. Amenities including coin-operated showers, a laundromat, water hookups at RV sites, internet access, and an online booking system are all explicitly stated in the website content; no hiker/biker-specific sites, device charging for non-RV guests, or cycling-specific services were mentioned.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone (250) 593-4431 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null as there is no OSM value to cross-check.

Two apparent template/placeholder Greek address strings ('Doukos Mpofor 16, Iraklio 712 02' and 'Leof. Nearchou, Iraklio 712 02') appear in the rendered website body — these are likely unfilled website-builder placeholders and do not represent a real address for this business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Loon Bay Resort is a legitimate, active campground with RV sites, showers, laundry, water, and online booking along Fishing Highway 24 — a cycling-relevant corridor in the Cariboo — making it a genuinely useful listing for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: coin-operated showers, a laundromat, water hookups at RV sites... along Fishing Highway 24
